sources.title: Transperth System Map — Updated October 2025 (Byford Rail Extension System Map)

sources.role: line timetable PDFs (ordered cover stacks + footnotes)

notes: D1 oracle is the official Transperth System Map (Updated October 2025) plus passenger train timetable PDF covers and footnotes. Stations arrays are hand-transcribed from those covers in printed cover order. Not generated from GTFS. Not generated from lib/cities/perth/line-map.json. LiveTimes/line-map are H2 name clash only.
City stays live. Modes v1: TRAIN only (Transperth suburban passenger rail). Bus, ferry, CAT, Transwa Australind are on the same map or stations index; they are out of the oracle.
Timezone Australia/Perth has NO DST. Do not copy Adelaide DST. Wall-clock is AWST year-round.

No T-numbers. Passenger product is line name + terminus. Map index and map legend print eight lines: Airport, Armadale, Ellenbrook, Fremantle, Mandurah, Midland, Thornlie-Cockburn, Yanchep. Timetable covers print the same eight names (Thornlie cover stacks as 'Thornlie - Cockburn Line').

Locked inner-city printed names from the map (three distinct stations, do not collapse): Perth; Perth Underground; Elizabeth Quay. Map also prints Perth Stadium (dashed / Special Events Station) on the Armadale / Thornlie-Cockburn corridor. Stations & Maps dropdown prints Perth Station / Perth Underground Station / Elizabeth Quay Station / Perth Stadium Station. Timetable covers print the bare map strings. LiveTimes prints * Stn.
Byford is printed open on the October 2025 map as the Armadale Line outer terminus, and is on the Armadale Line 13/10/2025 cover (Perth ... Armadale, Byford). Include it.
Ellenbrook is a printed live line (map legend bright red / Ellenbrook Line) branching at Bayswater: Morley, Noranda, Ballajura, Whiteman Park, Ellenbrook. Do not fold into Midland or Airport.

Airport–Fremantle through-running: the October 2025 map draws Airport Line colour along the full Fremantle corridor to Fremantle. Airport Line timetable cover (13/10/2025) lists High Wycombe–Claremont only (To Claremont / To High Wycombe). Fremantle Line 01/02/2026 footnote T: 'This trip is a continuation of an Airport Line service' (High Wycombe–Claremont on the Airport booklet; Claremont–Fremantle on the Fremantle booklet). D1 Airport Line row therefore includes the map through-run to Fremantle. West-of-Claremont stations are transcribed from the Fremantle cover (same printed strings), not invented.

Yanchep and Mandurah are two printed lines that meet at Perth Underground / Elizabeth Quay (north–south tunnel). Covers do not list Perth (surface) as a Yanchep or Mandurah stop. Do not treat them as inbound/outbound vs a single hub.
Thornlie-Cockburn Line cover ends at Cockburn Central. Shared with Mandurah at Cockburn Central only. Do not attach Mandurah, Lakelands, Warnbro, Wellard, Rockingham, Kwinana, Aubin Grove to TCL.

Showgrounds is on the Fremantle and Airport covers and is a dashed Special Events Station on the map. Left in the stations arrays because the line pages print it. Coverage note: LiveTimes Fremantle filter omits Showgrounds Stn.
Perth Stadium is on the Armadale and Thornlie-Cockburn covers and is dashed Special Events Station on the map. Left in those stations arrays because the line pages print it.

Short workings printed as timetable footnote codes, not separate D1 rows: Yanchep K terminates Clarkson / W terminates Whitfords; Mandurah W terminates Cockburn Central; Fremantle C terminates Claremont; Airport P terminates Perth. No printed Armadale-short-of-Byford code on the 13/10/2025 Armadale booklet. No printed Butler-terminate code on the Yanchep booklet.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown left empty: the live Perth product is Transperth LiveTimes XML, not GTFS. H2 used line-map.json (LiveTimes * Stn names) only to clash. No stopIds in this file.

printedInnerCityNames.doNotCollapse: Perth, Perth Underground and Elizabeth Quay are three printed stations on the October 2025 map. Do not emit a single 'Perth Station' blob. Do not treat Perth Underground as an alias of Perth.
printedInnerCityNames.stationsAndMapsSuffix: Perth Station / Perth Underground Station / Elizabeth Quay Station / Perth Stadium Station
printedInnerCityNames.liveTimesSuffix: Perth Stn / Perth Underground Stn / Elizabeth Quay Stn / Perth Stadium Stn

coverageGaps: Airport Line timetable cover stops at Claremont; map colour and Fremantle T-footnote through-run to Fremantle. West-of-Claremont Airport stations are taken from the Fremantle cover + map, not from the Airport cover stack.
Showgrounds is cover-listed and map-dashed Special Events. LiveTimes Fremantle station filter omits it.
Perth Stadium is cover-listed on Armadale and Thornlie-Cockburn and map-dashed Special Events.

Map prints bus stations (Karrinyup, Scarborough Beach, Mirrabooka, Galleria, Kalamunda, Booragoon, Curtin Central / Curtin University, Causeway, etc.) and ferry (Elizabeth Quay Jetty, Mends St). Out of v1 TRAIN oracle.

PDF hex colours are not printed as text; colour families cited from map legend swatches only (Airport teal, Fremantle blue, Yanchep olive, Mandurah orange, Armadale yellow, Midland dark red, Thornlie-Cockburn purple, Ellenbrook bright red).
Composite Perth–Bayswater / Perth–Cannington / Perth–Claremont booklets are linked from the train index; they were not used as all-stops oracles (covers already list the shared inners).
Kenwick is on the Armadale Line cover only. Thornlie-Cockburn cover jumps Beckenham → Thornlie; do not attach Kenwick to TCL.
